title: フェブラリーSの後に・くやしい？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara takes first place in the February Stakes. Determined to make her friends in the shopping district even happier, she is filled with motivation to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide her next race should be one that's a slightly longer distance, the Elm Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, while on her way to the winning concert, Haru Urara runs into a friend of hers who is down in the dumps from losing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her friend bitterly laments not having won the race and being unable to perform center stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is completely shocked to see another side of her friend, who is usually so cheerful.
